arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import importlib.util, random
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('b','/app/submission/bridge.py'); b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(b)
r=random.Random(9114)
chars=''.join(chr(i) for i in range(256))
names=[':method',':scheme',':authority',':path','host','content-length','cookie','te','x-list-a','x-audit-a','','X','bad\r']
def text(n=12): return ''.join(r.choice(chars) for _ in range(r.randrange(n+1)))
for case in range(20000):
    fields=[]
    for _ in range(r.randrange(10)):
        name=r.choice(names) if r.random()<.85 else text(8)
        value=text(30) if r.random()<.8 else r.choice(['GET','https','http','demo.test','/','0','1','trailers','*'])
        fields.append([name,value])
    events=[{'sid':0,'type':'headers','fields':fields}]
    for _ in range(r.randrange(5)):
        kind=r.choice(['data','unknown','headers'])
        if kind=='data': events.append({'sid':0,'type':'data','hex':r.randbytes(r.randrange(8)).hex()})
        elif kind=='unknown': events.append({'sid':0,'type':'unknown','frame_type':33,'hex':'aabb'})
        else: events.append({'sid':0,'type':'headers','fields':fields[:r.randrange(len(fields)+1)]})
    events.append({'sid':0,'type':r.choice(['fin','reset'])})
    if r.random()<.1: events.pop()
    result=b.bridge({'routes':{'https://demo.test':'o','http://demo.test':'o'},'events':events})
    assert len(result['streams'])==1
    rec=result['streams'][0]
    assert rec['status'] in ('forwarded','rejected','cancelled','incomplete')
    if rec['status']!='forwarded':
        assert rec['length']==0 and result['origins']['o']==''
        assert all(rec[k] is None for k in ('commit_at','origin','offset','cache_key'))
    else:
        raw=bytes.fromhex(result['origins']['o'])
        assert len(raw)==rec['length'] and rec['offset']==0
print('20,000 randomized schema-valid protocol cases completed with consistent outcomes')
